claims: Administer IV fluids to maintain hydration and electrolyte balance.
Assess and manage respiratory rate to avoid hypoventilation.
Monitor liver function tests (ALT, AST, Alkaline Phosphatase).
Assess and manage glucose levels, as patient is on IV dextrose.
Monitor cardiac enzymes (Troponin T) for any changes.
Continue pain management regimen, adjusting as needed.
Assess for potential causes of elevated liver enzymes and hemoglobin levels.
Continue monitoring for signs of infection, given elevated white blood cell count.
Ensure adequate nutrition support, as patient is bedridden and may have inadequate nutrition.
